low: slash more than 0.01 percent of validators
split more than 0.01 percent of the network
bring down more than 0.01 percent with one packet or onchain transaction
medium: slash more than 1 percent of validators
split more than 5 percent of the network
bring down more than 5 percent with one packet or onchain transaction
high: slash more than 33 percent of validators
split more than 33 percent of the network
bring down more than 33 percent with one onchain transaction
critical: slash more than 50 percent of validators
finalize an easily created infinite amount of ETH
steal or burn ETH from all EOAs
take down the entire network with one malicious onchain transaction

eligibility_note: Property eligibility identifies an in-scope vulnerability class, not an award decision. A report still needs a private, reproducible PoC, current mainnet impact, and must not depend on exposing the trusted Engine API publicly.
